node.title: Re^2: Reference found where even-sized list expected
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Or, as of Perl v5.22, the experimental [doc://perlref#Assigning-to-References|"refaliasing"] feature can be used, allowing one to access %info as if it were a regular hash, without having to make a copy of it:

use experimental 'refaliasing'; \my %info = get_mp3info($file); for my $key (keys %info) { print "$key / $info{$key}\n"; }
